reason: Tuesday is dead for me and that is the night this is built for, so if a bracket on the screen gets twenty regulars in on a dead night it pays for itself the first evening. At 1,500 with a free month and no contract I am risking an evening of my time, not my cash.
objection: The prize still comes out of my till. The software says it never touches the money, which also means it does nothing to fund the prize, so on a weak Tuesday I am paying the subscription and the prize and hoping the bar covers both.
would_change_my_mind: If I had to commit for a year or pay anything upfront I would walk away; the free month with no contract is the only reason I am saying yes.
